snippet.title: Donald Trump waives Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies | BBC News
snippet.description:
Donald Trump has blocked numerous sanctions on Russia two days before they were due to take effect, as a row with his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelensky deepens.

The sanctions were passed by the US Congress and signed into law by Trump in September.

But the US president issued an executive order on Friday night saying that suspending some was in the US "national interest", prompting a backlash from US lawmakers.

It comes after the White House said Katie Zacharia is "transitioning out" of the role of press secretary just days after taking the job. 
 
The US president said on Friday he suggested to Zacharia she should "reconsider" the job.

snippet.title: America's Tesla Blows Up The Entire Aviation Industry With An Unexpected Announcement
snippet.description:
Boom Supersonic, the startup Silicon Valley has quietly nicknamed America's Tesla, just made an announcement that shook the global aviation industry. An engine that every major manufacturer on Earth publicly refused to build fired up to full takeoff thrust on a test stand in the United States, and the company simultaneously put American domestic supersonic routes on the map for the first time since 1973. New York to Los Angeles in just over 3 hours, Seattle to Miami in under 4, all made possible by a 2025 executive order replacing the FAA's blanket ban on supersonic overland flight with a noise standard that Boom's boomless cruise technology was engineered to pass.

The airplane at the center of this story is Overture, a Mach 1.7 supersonic airliner carrying 64 to 80 passengers in an all-premium cabin at roughly business class prices, with a range of 4,250 nautical miles. United Airlines, American Airlines, and Japan Airlines have together reserved more than 130 aircraft, a backlog worth over 26 billion dollars. The engine, called Symphony, is a medium bypass turbofan designed for sustained supersonic cruise without afterburners and capable of running on 100 percent sustainable fuel. But the most unexpected move was Boom's side business: a gas turbine called Superpower, derived from the Symphony core, producing 42 megawatts each, with Crusoe ordering 29 units to power AI data centers. That turbine business is quietly funding the company while Overture is assembled in Greensboro, North Carolina, and logging thousands of real operating hours on the engine core before it ever hangs on a wing. With first flight slipped to 2028 and passenger service projected for 2031, the delay may actually leave Boom stronger, not weaker, because paying customers are already funding the dream.

snippet.title: The easiest chicken congee you’ll ever make (using a rotisserie chicken)
snippet.description:
RICE CONGEE USING A ROTISSERIE CHICKEN (CHAO GA)

INGREDIENTS
1 rotisserie chicken
1 onion, peeled
4 to 5 slices ginger (about ⅛-inch thick)
8 cups water
1½ cups white rice, rinsed (I used jasmine rice)

FOR SEASONING
Fish sauce
Chicken bouillon
Salt
Sugar

FOR SERVING
Chopped cilantro
Chopped scallions
Fried shallots
Julienned ginger
Black pepper
Instructions

1. Shred all of the meat from the rotisserie chicken and set aside. Place the chicken bones, carcass, and skin into a large pot along with the onion, ginger slices, and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer. Simmer for 30 to 45 minutes to create a simple chicken stock.

2. Remove and discard the bones, onion, and ginger, leaving only the broth in the pot.

3. Add the rinsed rice to the broth. Simmer for 45 to 60 minutes, or until the congee reaches your desired consistency. Stir occasionally to prevent the rice from sticking to the bottom of the pot.

4. Season to taste with fish sauce, chicken bouillon, salt, and/or sugar.

5. Add half of the shredded chicken into rice congee (save other half for chicken salad) Garnish with scallions, cilantro, fried shallots, julienned ginger, black pepper, and any other toppings you enjoy.

NOTE
For a thicker congee, simmer longer.
For a thinner consistency, add more water or broth as needed.
Adjust the seasonings to your taste preference. e.

snippet.title: Lula já virou  Mas precisa ampliar a vantagem
snippet.description:
O professor e jornalista Felipe Pena (@_felipepena__) comenta sobre as pesquisas Quaest e Datafolha, que confirmam a possibilidade de virada de Lula prevista por ele no início da semana: a mesma curva ascendente de Lula e descendente de Flávio vista na PoderData, com os trackings de PT e PL já indicando Lula um ou dois pontos à frente. Para garantir a eleição, Pena calcula que ele precisa chegar a uns quatro pontos de vantagem, e mostra de onde podem vir os votos: 10% dos eleitores de Flávio decidiram só no último dia, contra 5% de Lula, e convencer metade deles já representa 5 milhões de votos, mais que o dobro da diferença do primeiro turno (2,2 milhões). Ele aponta quatro razões para acreditar: a agenda do fim da 6x1, aprovada no Senado; os debates; as redes; e as ruas. E um dado da Quaest: 42% votam em Flávio só para tirar Lula. Assista.
